fields.Name: T94 - Query Total Outstanding Invoice Balance
fields.Description: Runs a saved query that needs no input parameters and verifies tabular results.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer > Queries (queries are grouped in folders in the left panel). Find a query that is Approved (green dot) and has NO required parameters — use the LEFT sidebar 'Search queries...' box, or pick one from a visible folder (e.g. 'Server Installed Version History' or 'Entities with Field Counts' under the Admin folder). AVOID queries marked 'Pending' or showing required-parameter asterisks. Select the query and click Run; verify results display in a table with data rows. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A no-parameter Approved query was located (via the 'Search queries...' box or a visible folder) and run
Query results are displayed in a table with data rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
